title: Presence Bridge
summary: See who is free, then open the chat tool you already use.
user: Two-to-ten person businesses that need a clean desktop chat presence indicator and one-click contact handoff without moving conversations.
smallest_useful_product: Cross-platform tray app with manually set and calendar-derived availability, a local team roster, and configurable deep links to existing chat and call tools.
constraints: Presence is opt-in and transparent. No activity inference, message transport, contact scraping, employee surveillance, or new social network.
